g.text: An LLM investigates. ASCENT exposes evidence. Aitia controls effects.
What makes this a learning loop?

svg.aria-label: What makes this a learning loop?

g.text: How does evidence inform the next question?
inform; do not rank or choose
LLM judgment stays open. Evidence stays inspectable. Effects stay authorized.
Formation authority is design-only. Consuming hosts own actual execution/evidence; this view grants no application authorization.
